verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ay chawanh winak ix och preso: Ha jun winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, haxo junxo winh, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' winh b'o'um pan swa winh rey chi'. Ay smul heb' winh ix och t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh rey to tz'ak'ji'och heb' winh t'a preso t'a spat winh yajal t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh, haton ta' aypaxoch winhaj José t'a preso.
Hanheja' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' ix kan heb' winh chawanh smunlajwum winh rey chi' yuj winh yajal preso chi' yik ha winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' winh. Ix kan heb' winh jun pekti' t'a preso chi'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal ix och swayich heb' winh chawanh chi', junjun wayich chi' ay syalelk'ochi.
Haxo ix sakb'i ix k'och winhaj José yil heb' winh. Ix yilan winh to te ayoch heb' winh t'a ilk'olal.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj te kuseltak yilji he sat? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

--Ay wal ko wayich ix och t'a jun ak'wal tik, palta malaj mach t'a tik tz'alan t'ayonh tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh. --¿Tom manhok Dios syal yalani tas syalelk'och wayich? Alek t'ayin tas ix he wayichej chi', xchi winhaj José chi'.
Yuj chi' ha winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix och ijan winh yalan swayich chi' t'a winhaj José icha tik: --Ha t'a hin wayich, ix wil jun te' uwa,
ay oxe' sk'ab' te'. Ix wil sk'eta swol, ix yak'an xumakil, haxo xumakil chi', ix och b'uyan sat, te k'inhxo.
Ha ix wilani to yamb'ilk'e skopa winh rey wu'uj, ix wik'ankot sat te' uwa chi', ix hin pitz'anem yal t'a yol skopa winh rey chi', ix wak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ichaton tik syalelk'och ha wayich chi': Ha oxe' sk'ab' te' uwa ix il chi', oxe' k'uhal syala'.
Ayik chab'ej tikne'ik ol sb'eyk'olej ha mul winh rey chi'. Ol lajwok chi' ol hach yak'anxi'och winh t'a ha munlajel, ol ak'xi skopa winh chi' icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Ayik ol elk'och jun swal tik, tzin ha na'ankot t'a winh rey chi', yik wach' tzin elpax t'a yol preso tik. Ok'okab' ha k'o'ol t'ayin.
Ha hin tik ichato elk'ab'il hin kot t'a skal heb' winh hebreo. Manh hin mojok ay hin och t'a preso tik, yujto malaj jab'ok tas chuk ix hin k'ulej, xchi winhaj José chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh yajalil heb' winh sb'o'an ixim pan to ha winhaj José wach' ix aj yalanel swayich winh chi' winh, ix yalanpax winh icha tik: --Ha hin tik ix hin wayichej to ayk'e oxe' mo'och ixim pan t'a hin jolom.

Ha t'a yol jun yune' mo'och t'a jun yoxil ayk'e t'a hin jolom chi', tzijtum makanhil ixim pan ayem t'a yo'ol yik swa winh rey, palta haxo nok' much ix jawi ix stzok'ank'eta ixim nok' t'a yol te' mo'och chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj José t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tas syalelk'och ha wayich chi', haton tik: Ha oxe' mo'och chi' sch'oxkot oxe' k'uhal.

Yuj chi' yik chab'ej tikne'ik, ol sb'eyk'olej winh rey tas yaj ha mul. Slajwi chi' ol schekan winh ik'chajel ha jolom, ha ha niwanil ol ak'jokk'e t'a schon jun te te', haxo nok' ostok ol ja schib'at ha niwanil chi', xchi winhaj José chi' t'a winh.

Schab'ji'al wal yalan swayich heb' winh chawanh chi' winhaj José chi', ix yak'an sk'inhal yab'ilal winh rey. Ix yawtankot winh masanil heb' winh niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok. T'a yichanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' ix chekji ik'chajelta heb' winh chawanh ayoch t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey, ix ak'chajxi'och winh t'a smunlajel.
Haxo winh yajal yaj t'a heb' sb'o'an ixim pan, ix yal winh rey to smiljicham winh icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj José.
Palta majxo nachajkot winhaj José yuj winh tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi'.
